descriptor.name: Delaware State Parcels (FirstMap) — statewide
descriptor.licenceNote: Source conditions are informational; users choose their source and intended use.
descriptor.operator: State of Delaware FirstMap; county parcel data
descriptor.scope: Delaware state parcel layer, all three counties. PIN is county-assigned with county-specific formats, so the native key is COUNTY plus PIN.
caveats: Offset paging on this service returned the same object twice across pages (Wilmington, 2026-10-12); bounded reads use complete count/object-ID manifests.

This service evaluates any comparison with an empty-string literal as unknown (PIN <> '' and PIN NOT IN ('',' ') match zero rows), so no blank-string exclusion is configured; the 6 blank PINs statewide are NULL and are excluded by attributeNotNull. One PIN carries a leading or trailing space and is kept verbatim.
Same endpoint as us-de-kent-dover-parcels (COUNTY=Kent, key PIN under US-DE-KENT-); Kent County parcels would exist under both namespaces.
descriptor.attribution: State of Delaware FirstMap and Delaware counties. Adapted to WGS84.

jurisdiction.basis: FirstMap layer "State Parcels" covers Delaware; all three counties (Kent, New Castle, Sussex) present on 2026-10-12.

evidence: FirstMap layer "State Parcels" covers Delaware; all three counties (Kent, New Castle, Sussex) present on 2026-10-12.
